items.title: FBI is investigating a possible killing aboard a cruise ship out of Texas
items.brief: The FBI is investigating a “suspected homicide” aboard a cruise ship that returned to port after departing from Galveston, Texas, the agency said in a statement Monday.

items.title: France blames Iran for ‘unprecedented’ supermarket fridge cyberattack
items.brief: France is blaming Iran for last month’s supermarket refrigerator cyberattack , which spoiled produce at around 700 retailers, and is vowing to slap sanctions on Tehran in response.
